comments.body:
I started a PR for this in https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-import-export/pull/135

While it does allow the import of BTR profiles, there is no real validation of the Bag done against the profile, so I considered the PR to be scoped toward export support.
Michael Ritter: would you mind changing the description and scope of the JIRA to be limited to what is captured in your pr-135... and create one or more JIRAs for subsequent tasks?
Andrew Woods Thanks for the suggestion - I captured the remaining item (validation on import) in FCREPO-3184 Closed .
With the update to the scope of this issue it's now ready for review - https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-import-export/pull/135

renderedFields.description:
The beyond the repository grant has developed a BagIt Profile which needs to be supported in the import export tool.

  • The Fedora Import/Export tool needs to be able to generate an export package that is a BagIt Bag that conforms to the BTR BagIt Profile
  • After performing an export into the BTR format and removing the objects contained in that export from the Fedora repository, the Fedora Import/Export tool is able to re-ingest the contents of the bag such that the original repository contents are restored.
  • Tests are in place which demonstrate both export and import of repository content using the BTR BagIt Profile.
  • Documentation for the Import/Export tool is updated based on changes made.
